items: Preserve repository infrastructure validity throughout the repair process.
Prefer deterministic, minimal workspace changes that address the task without altering unrelated components.
Freeze a candidate only after a complete and coherent workspace delta is in place.
Ensure policy compliance even when no public test harness is reachable.
Treat repository repair as a structured sequence of tool invocations leading to a stable final state.
When public tests are absent or unreachable, validate through internal consistency checks and workspace inspection.
Do not assume test failure from missing public test signals; treat unreached tests as zero information.
If public tests exist later, design the candidate to be compatible with the expected harness.
Prioritize changes that do not require public tool calls to be recognized as a valid candidate.
Keep the workspace clean and well-scoped; avoid stray or unreferenced edits.
Record a workspace delta that reflects only intentional repair actions.
Verify file state and metadata before freezing a candidate.
Align the final workspace with policy constraints and infrastructure requirements.
Use tool invocations deliberately; each invocation should move the workspace toward a consistent candidate.
Confirm that the original failure labels are empty; do not chase nonexistent symptoms.
Review the workspace delta to ensure the repair is materially present.
Check that all preceding tool invocations completed successfully and in the proper order.
Verify that no public tests were reported as failed; unresolved test status is not a failure.
Ensure candidate freeze occurs only after the workspace has settled.
Prefer zero-line or no-op patches if the existing workspace already satisfies the task.
Avoid introducing changes when changed-file metrics are zero; respect the final state.
Delay candidate freeze until the delta is identical to the intended repair.
Keep patch production separate from exploration; freeze only a deliberate final snapshot.
Maintain a reproducible final state by aligning workspace delta with candidate freeze.
